name: ragdemo.ai
description: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) is a technique that enhances the capabilities of LLMs by combining retrieval with text generation. Instead of relying on pre-trained knowledge, RAG will generate content from the defined sources to get more accurate knowledge rather a generic response.

paragraphs: Developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) application using Google Gemini AI to generate context-aware responses grounded in user-provided documents rather than relying solely on the LLM's pre-trained knowledge. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) is a technique that enhances the capabilities of LLMs by combining retrieval with text generation. Instead of relying on pre-trained knowledge, RAG will generate content from the defined sources to get more accurate knowledge rather a generic response.
